title: Arcane Metals
body:
## Fantasy Metals Expansion

This mod expands the vanilla Minecraft experience by introducing a selection of **vanilla-friendly, fantasy-inspired metals**. These new materials are carefully designed to fit naturally into the game’s progression and world generation.

### Features
- ⛏️ **New Ores** that generate naturally alongside existing vanilla ores  
- ⚔️ **Tools & Weapons** with balanced stats that complement vanilla gameplay  
- 🛡️ **Armor Sets** inspired by classic fantasy metals  
- 🌍 Seamless integration into the **vanilla art style and balance**

### Design Philosophy
The mod focuses on enhancing exploration and progression without breaking immersion. All items are tuned to feel rewarding while avoiding power creep, making them ideal for both survival and light modded playthroughs.

Perfect for players who want **more variety** while keeping the **classic Minecraft feel**.
